name: Sabores do Campo
description: The authentic taste of the Portuguese countryside.
story: Sabores do Campo is a cooperative of local farmers in Portugal, dedicated to bringing fresh, high-quality produce to tables across the country. We believe in supporting local talent and see motorsport as a way to connect with communities and showcase the passion that goes into everything we do. We seek a partnership that aligns with our values of hard work, dedication, and a commitment to excellence.
